title: Kinematics reasoning
description: Important: Correctly uses the kinematic equation for displacement under constant acceleration starting from rest (e.g., x = 1/2 a t²).

title: Newton's law application

title: Unit consistency

title: Misapplied average velocity
description: Pitfall: Uses (initial+final)/2 for average velocity without justification, or confuses it with instantaneous velocity.

title: Sign or formula error
description: Pitfall: Uses an incorrect kinematic formula (e.g., x = v₀t + at²) or makes an algebraic mistake solving for acceleration.
